data.exact_reserve_text: An unfavourable run-off deviation (prior accident years' increase) of GBP 4.7m (2016: favorable run-off deviation of GBP 2.5m) was experienced during the year, wholly in respect of reserve movements on the 2015 year of account and prior Whole Account Quota Share contract with Syndicate 2003.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced an unfavourable run-off deviation of GBP 4.7 million in 2017, representing a strengthening of prior year reserves. This was primarily due to reserve movements on the 2015 year of account and the Whole Account Quota Share contract with Syndicate 2003.

data.data_quality_notes: The explicit prior year development figure of GBP 4.7m from the 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note on page 17 is used as the primary source. This figure is significantly lower than the GBP 19.038m calculated from the gross claims development triangle on page 19 for underwriting years 2015 and prior. The explicit note is considered more direct for the reported PYD. The named events (Hurricanes Harvey, Irma, Maria, California Wildfires) are mentioned in the Strategic Report as impacting 2017 performance, not explicitly linked to the GBP 4.7m prior year development.
